description: Shows Goce Petrov's selected work, his services with prices and a short brief form as an interactive card in the chat. Use when someone wants to see his work, compare his services, or start a project with him. Hosts without in-chat apps get the same facts as text. view opens a tab (work, offer or brief); service preselects one service for the brief; sector filters the work.

sector.description: Show only case studies from this sector

service.description: A service id from get_services, to preselect it in the brief

view.description: The tab to open: work, offer or brief

name: show_work_and_offer
title: Goce Petrov: work and offer
